hadith:
Laws of Inheritance (Al-Faraa'id) - Narrated Ibn `Abbas:

The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Give the Fara'id, (the shares prescribed in the Qur'an) to those who are entitled to receive it, and then whatever remains, should be given to the closest male relative of the deceased."
message: Seek the Hereafter with sincerity, not merely worldly gain; Allah promises a great reward to those who strive in His cause. Remember that Al-Hafeez knows every deed, and honor the prescribed inheritance shares of those entitled to them.
name:
Al Hafeez - الْحَفِيظُ - The Preserver

Al Hafeez describes Allah's preservation and watchfulness. He keeps account of all things and knows every action of His creatures. This name encourages His servants to seek His protection and live with awareness of His care.
verse:
An-Nisa - The Women - 4:72-74

There will be some among you who will lag behind so that if you face a disaster, they will say, “Allah has blessed us for not being there among them.”

But if you return with Allah’s bounties, they will say—as if there had been no bond between you—“We wish we had been there with them to share the great gain!”

Let those who would sacrifice this life for the Hereafter fight in the cause of Allah. And whoever fights in Allah’s cause—whether they achieve martyrdom or victory—We will honour them with a great reward.
